svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 10 (CUMULATIVE R490 MILESTONE) · AI DATABASE & DUAL-TIER RAG ARCHITECTURE
yzsind/mydb (1.32M QPS HTAP+MCP) + mitdbg/pgvectorfast (Calico Buffer Pool) + Dual-Tier RAG
1. yzsind/mydb v1.0.0 (★52 · 10 forks · Rust · Apache-2.0)
MySQL 8.0 wire/binlog compatible + automatic Zone Maps OLAP + queryable backups
Built-in REST/MCP interfaces, native vector/full-text RRF & SQL model calls
2. mitdbg/pgvectorfast (★17 · MIT Data Systems Lab · PG 18/19)
• 100% SQL & on-disk drop-in replacement for pgvector (arXiv:2604.00423 Calico pool)
• Two-level array page translation + ~100% HNSW relation prefix cache hit rate
• Lock-free optimistic reads (calico.optimistic_reads) + io_uring HNSW group prefetch
• Guardrail: Use Debian 12/13 PGDG or zxjcarrot/pgvectorfast:pg18 (avoid Ubuntu -flto=auto)
3. Golden-66/agentic-rag-kb (★25 · LangGraph + Milvus · MIT)
• Heavy Internal PDF Pipeline with Reranker Fast-Path Gate
MinerU layout/table OCR ➔ Heading parent-child chunks ➔ BGE-M3 + BM25 RRF fusion
BGE-Reranker-v2-m3 high-score fast path skips expensive LLM judge grading
4. Replyze/ai-customer-support-agent (★19 · Pure BM25 · MIT)
• 6-module zero-vector-DB Python support agent over Markdown help articles
• Emits structured JSON with exact section citations (shipping.md#delivery-times)
• Deterministic handoff on anger, refunds, charge disputes, legal or security issues
• Treats visitor input strictly as untrusted data to block prompt injection
💰 CLOSED-FORM FINOPS BENCHMARK (CLAIM-20261118-R10-MYDB-PGVECTORFAST-AGENTICRAG · 100M ROWS + 500K QUERIES)
• Path A (MySQL+CK+Milvus Clusters + Every-Turn LLM Judge): $2,680.00 infra/API + $4,300.00 labor (43.0h) = $6,980.00 / mo
• Path B (Oversized RDS pgvector + Monolithic Vector RAG): $1,240.00 infra/API + $1,800.00 labor (18.0h) = $3,040.00 / mo
• Path C (MyDB/pgvectorfast + Dual-Tier RAG Routing): $125.00 infra/API + $320.00 labor (3.2h) = $445.00 / mo (-$6,535.00/mo · -93.62%)
